title: Tenkaichi: The Greatest Warrior Under the Rising Sun First Trailer Reveals Main Staff and Cast
content: Tenkaichi: The Greatest Warrior Under the Rising Sun anime revealed its first trailer and a new visual, along with an April 2027 release date. The anime was announced in April 2025.
author: Anime Corner

title: Rudy Meets Perugius in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 8 Preview
content: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 8 preview images and synopsis ahead of its August 16 premiere. The episode is set to begin the Chaos Breaker arc , which recently revealed a trailer. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup .

title: 'Tenkaichi' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo, Spring 2027 Premiere
content: An official website opened for the television anime adaptation of Yousuke Nakamaru and Kyoutarou Azuma 's Tenkaichi: Nihon Saikyou Bugeisha Ketteisen ( Tenkaichi: The Greatest Warrior Under the Rising Sun ) manga revealed the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video on Thursday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Houston Man Charged For Terroristic Threat Over Anime
content: A man from Houston, Texas has been charged with a third-degree felony count of terroristic threat against a public servant after allegedly leaving a profanity-ridden voicemail to the Governor's Office related to anime.
author: ANN

title: 'Kinsou no Vermeil' Manga Artist Youko Umezu Dies
content: Manga artist Youko Umezu , best known as the illustrator for Kouta Amana 's Kinsou no Vermeil ( Vermeil in Gold ) manga, died on July 7 due to a cerebral infarction. A funeral service was held by her close relatives.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Live-Action High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku Film Reveals More Cast
content: The official website for the live-action film of Ryō Nakama 's High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku ( Kōkōsei Kazoku ) manga announced seven more cast members for the film on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Altair: A Record of Battles' Kotono Katō Launches New Manga
content: Manga creator Kotono Katō launched a new manga titled Set Match! in Kodansha 's Comic Days app on August 7. The manga debuted with two chapters. The manga centers on Haruha, a timid girl who is is careless with punctuality.
author: ANN
